ratings.note: Every booking passes the vehicle step without the chosen day/time (screenshot); only a memory load, and the choice was made seconds earlier, so it does not recur in a way that hurts. s=2.
Only on a failed Next on the vehicle step; following the link scrolls but leaves focus off the control, so keyboard/SR users need extra navigation each time. s=2.

Screenshots show Morning/Afternoon grids missing the Few-left times, which sit in an unlabelled row above; users scanning by period may pick a later slot, but the times are still visible on the page. s=2.
Cancelled done page is reached rarely; when it is, a screen reader announces 'Booked' first, a significant misreading of the outcome until the status line is read. s=2.

Changing an existing booking is a declared core task, yet there is no online route at all, only a weekday phone line (done page text); outside office hours the task is blocked and otherwise it costs a support contact. Plans change occasionally. s=4.
Expired-hold screenshot: the filled 'Book this slot' still dominates while the real step is a small 'Change slot' link; occurs only on expiry and is understood after one failed press. s=2.
Morning-of booking is a declared common scene; early same-day slots render as free and are refused only after all three steps, forcing a restart. Recurs on later same-day bookings. s=3.
No hold time is stated on any step (ARIA absence); residents who book while doing something else lose the slot only at submit and must re-choose. Once learned they hurry. s=3.
Same gap as the hold-time finding, with the WCAG 2.2.1 angle for slower AT users; expiry surfaces only as an error after submit (expired screenshot). s=3.
320px capture shows about 15px overflow beside the card and footer; only at 320 CSS px (narrow phones or high zoom), causing slight horizontal shift, content still readable. s=1.

Every booking has a 1.5 s commit wait with no visible change (probe t400/t1000 unchanged); in this product a repeat tap cancels the booking, so the missing feedback leads to a significant error, not just uncertainty. s=3.
Expired-hold screenshot: plain 'This slot is no longer available.' with no instruction or link, and the lost time replaced by '–'; recoverable via the adjacent Change slot link once noticed. s=2.

A 5-minute client-side limit across three steps with personal details is easily exceeded by multitasking or AT users; no warning, display or extension (WCAG 2.2.1), so the slot is lost at the last step. s=3.

Car selected but 'Permit number / Starts DRC-' remains directly under the vehicle buttons (screenshot); causes hesitation for car owners who do not know the rule, but an empty field proceeds. Recurs given bookings a few times a year. s=2.
Vehicle screenshot shows the permit field with no 'vans and trailers only' wording in every state; hesitation for many car users, no block. s=2.
Van/trailer users only; the rule is behind an icon-only (i), though the visible permit field itself signals a permit is involved and the first page states the rule. s=2.
Post-submit errors (permit, past slot, expiry) are plain text while field errors are links; users must find 'Change vehicle' themselves. Occasional, recoverable. s=2.
Probes 18/36 show Change slot resets to Today and confirm then shows Monday 12; anyone moving a slot in the core change journey can silently book the wrong day, noticed only in the Day row. s=3.
Van owners without a permit cannot act on help text with no link or timing and must search the council site; a one-time hurdle per permit. s=2.
Every day choice shows an empty Slots area for about 0.9 s (probes t300/t700) and Next is silently ignored; brief, and slots appear before most users act. s=2.
Duplicate of the no-online-change gap: the core change task has no online path, only weekday phone hours, so it blocks evening/weekend users and forces support contact. s=4.
Forced-colours capture: selected day differs only by a 2px vs 1px border; contrast-theme users are few and the 'Saturday 17 October' line under Slots states the choice. s=1.
Default vehicle screenshot: permit field shown before any vehicle is chosen with the rule only behind (i); hesitation for car users, no block. s=2.

A double tap during the 1.5 s wait saves status 'cancelled' under a page headed 'Booked' (probe 79); the resident drives to the centre and is turned away. Double taps are occasional on phones among older users. s=4.
Probes 28/33/41: van with blank or digits-only permit passes Next and fails only after all personal details and Book, on a page without the field; significant rework for a core task. s=3.
Done page shows only the reference, not day, window or vehicle; residents relying on it at the gate (poor signal) may miss the 20-minute window; SMS reminder mitigates for some. s=3.

Cancelled screenshot: H1 'Booked' with the cancelled status as a red line and 'Show this at the gate' below; contradictory page can send a resident on a wasted trip. Occurs whenever a cancelled booking is viewed. s=3.
Same done-page gap from the walkthrough: time window absent from the page residents are told to keep; those who forget the time risk being turned away. s=3.
